clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 美联储沃什：点阵图提交无助于政策制定
title_lines: 称提交点阵图无助于政策
title_highlights: 提交点阵图无助于政策

subtitles.en: You said you don't like forward guidance, you dropped it from the statement this time, but with the dot plot nine members suggested that they want a rate increase by the end of the year and the markets have taken that as forward guidance. So what does this mean in terms of how you guide the markets and in terms of what the dot plot's future is.
subtitles.zh: 你说你不喜欢前瞻指引，这次也从声明中删除了，但点阵图显示九位成员希望年底前加息，市场将此视为前瞻指引。这对你引导市场的方式以及点阵图的未来意味着什么？

subtitles.en: I'm going to have to give you the same answer I gave to to miss Smith. We've got a task force for that. I'll give you a little bit more.
subtitles.zh: 我只能给你和史密斯女士一样的答案。我们有一个工作组负责此事。我再多说一点。

subtitles.en: I reviewed the dot plots and when I saw the submissions, I noted that all the submissions were coming in with pencils, you know, those kind of with the big erasers.
subtitles.zh: 我审阅了点阵图，看到提交时，所有提交都是用铅笔写的，那种带大橡皮的铅笔。

subtitles.en: That's to say that I think my colleagues around the table when they submitted their dots understand the world is changing quite quickly and they didn't feel bound by them six weeks from now or six days from now and in the event that their circumstances change.
subtitles.zh: 也就是说，我认为在座的同事提交点阵图时，明白世界变化很快，他们不觉得六周或六天后必须受其约束，如果情况有变的话。

subtitles.en: I'll note a couple other things. What I heard around the table was as they submitted their modal forecasts their modal forecast to be clear weren't this was more likely than not.
subtitles.zh: 我还要提几点。我在会上听到的是，他们在提交模态预测时，明确表示这并非最可能的情况，只是比其他情景可能性稍高。

subtitles.en: This was this was more likely than their other scenarios. So I didn't hear tons of conviction. What I heard was the kind of humility that I think we should have.
subtitles.zh: 所以我没有听到很强的信心。我听到的是我们应有的谦逊。
